GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS FOR “SPACE INVADERS” INSTALLATION: 1, Remove shipping cleats located on bottom of cabinet. 2. Install 4 provided leg \evelers to hottom of cabinet and level cabinet. 3. The power is controlled by a switch located on top of the cabinet. Plug into A.C. only, 115 volts, 60 cycles. In low line areas (105 volts or less), a boost in the output voltage of the transformer may be obtained by removing the wire from the 115 volt tap of the transformer and rewiring it to the 105 volt position. VOLTAGE CONTROL POTS: Located on power supply board (P.C. A080-90400-F000) and are preset at the factory. These pats should not be tampered with unless the Distributor Service Department is contacted. MASTER VOLUME CONTROL: Located on game logic board (P.C. AQ84-90700-B739) controls the volume of all sounds and may be varied as desired by rotating pots. ADJUSTMENT SWITCHES: Located on game logic board (P.C. AQ84-90700-8739) and may be adjusted as indicated on separate instruction sheet in back box area. 1. No. of Missile Bases per game: Adjustable 3 to 6. 2. Bonus Missile Base: Awarded at 1,000 or 1,500 points. ADJ. SW, VOLUME CONTROL P.C,A084-90700-B739 TO REMOVE CONTROL PANEL FOR SERVICE: 1. Open coin box door. 2. — Unplug contro! panel jack located to the left of coin box opening. 3. Uniatch (2) clamps located on each side of cabinet. 4. Remove control panel for service.
